title: Automated alternative-design explorer — Capability specification
body: Public edition. Public research and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Public edition. Public research and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Automated alternative-design explorer is a super-advanced writing and creation capability. Purpose: generates and compares different solutions against measurable objectives.. Inputs: a defined objective with constraints and acceptance criteria. Outputs: the specified artifact — code, design, analysis, or verified result — plus its evidence package. Constraints: available compute, data, tools, and permissions. Expected behavior: the capability either produces a verified result or reports exactly what is missing. Capability-development catalog: this entry describes a capability to be developed, not a claim that it already exists in one finished system. Implementation must be demonstrated through testing — every record carries an executed fragment plus its verification test.
